item.title: Resato Hydrogen Technology BV Files for Suspension of Payments
item.dc:creator: itaizul0011
item.description: Resato Hydrogen Technology BV Files for Suspension of Payments On July 21, an application for suspension of payments was filed on behalf of Resato Hydrogen Technology. This is unfortunate news that creates uncertainty for employees, customers, suppliers, and partners. After funding became uncertain, every effort was made to secure new financing in time for the next phase of Resato Hydrogen Technology (RHT). On Monday, July 20, it was concluded that while there is significant support and interest, there is not yet sufficient financing available for the immediate short term. As a result, the company cannot continue as is, making a stay of payments unavoidable. RHT is a well-known company based in Assen that manufactures hydrogen refueling stations and has rapidly grown to become a European technology leader and market leader in hydrogen mobility. Administrator Jeroen Sprangers (REIN) was appointed by the court on July 22 and immediately began his duties at RHT. With the administrator on board, the next steps are being determined. RHT, in collaboration with the administrator, is handling external communications with all stakeholders: customers, suppliers, and others. In recent weeks, as the financing issues have come to the fore, there have been many expressions of support and positive offers of assistance from politicians, industry organizations, and public and private entities in the Netherlands and Europe. Building on these positive developments, RHT hopes that a relaunch will be possible with one or more new short- and long-term financiers. Discussions are underway regarding several concrete leads, and RHT is open to serious candidates, preferably those with strategic synergies. Resato Hydrogen Technology is grateful to its customers, suppliers, and partners and proud of its employees. Together, they have made it possible for Resato Hydrogen Technology to complete the journey it has undertaken so far. We at RHT are fully committed to ensuring that we can still embark on the next phase. item.title: Getech Group plc Wins Landmark EUR 1 Million Plus European Commission Natural Hydrogen Contract
item.dc:creator: itaizul0011
item.description: Getech Group plc Wins Landmark EUR 1 Million Plus European Commission Natural Hydrogen Contract Getech Group plc announced that it has been selected as a key technical delivery partner in a consortium that has been awarded a major European Commission contract to deliver the first Europe-wide assessment of natural hydrogen potential and associated regulatory requirements, with an expected contract value to Getech Group plc of more than EUR 1 million, to be realised over the course of Fiscal Year 2026 and Fiscal Year 2027. The 12-month study, commissioned by the Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs (DG GROW), is titled “Mapping underground reservoirs of natural hydrogen in Europe and developing the necessary legislation for sustainable production”. Getech Group plc will deliver the main geological components of the study as part of a consortium led by Trinomics B.V. The project will develop the first Europe-wide view of the potential of Natural Hydrogen as a low carbon energy source by mapping geological settings favourable for natural hydrogen accumulations, across all EU Member States, assessing the feasibility of commercial extraction at selected locations and providing evidence-based recommendations to inform future regulation and market design. The award follows a competitive European Commission procurement process assessing technical capability, sector expertise and the ability to deliver a consistent Europe-wide evaluation across all Member States. In delivering the project, Getech Group plc will draw on its natural hydrogen exploration workflow experience, world-leading proprietary gravity and magnetic datasets and Globe geoscience platform, which together provide unique, consistent subsurface insight into this potentially transformative low carbon energy source. Getech Group plc’s revenue for the project will comprise consultancy, data and software licence fees. This project may also encourage other studies into this potentially transformational low carbon resource elsewhere in the world. Large parts of Africa, South America and Central Asia remain unexplored from a natural hydrogen perspective, despite strong geological indicators of substantial subsurface potential. Getech Group plc will be well positioned to participate in any such activities given its proprietary global datasets and the experience gained from this European Commission mandate providing a proven foundation from which to lead equivalent assessments. item.title: RTV Drenthe – Millions in deficit at Resato Hydrogen, company tries to avoid bankruptcy
item.dc:creator: itaizul0011
item.description: RTV Drenthe – Millions in deficit at Resato Hydrogen, company tries to avoid bankruptcy Resato Hydrogen Technology in Assen is struggling with financial problems. The company has therefore been granted a suspension of payments by the court. Such a request is filed to prevent bankruptcy. Resato Hydrogen Technology specializes in hydrogen refueling stations for hydrogen-powered vehicles, such as trucks, buses, and cars. The Assen-based company employs approximately 150 people. Growing pains The financial problems arose after financiers put the brakes on their investments. Administrator Jeroen Sprangers of REIN Advocaten , says: It is a true scale-up experiencing growing pains. ”The company is incredibly important in the world of hydrogen, but on the other hand, it needs a tremendous amount of money to be able to grow,” Sprangers , said: The money has run out for now, in a sense, and new money needs to come in Important company A payment deferral offers the possibility for the company to continue operating, unlike in the event of bankruptcy. The search for new financiers is complex for this company, Sprangers, explains, It gives us the peace of mind to freeze projects and to figure out which projects will allow us to secure the necessary funding. ”But much more importantly, we can use that time to secure other financing.The entire approach is to preserve this incredible technology for the Northern Netherlands and, in fact, for Europe, because that is how important it is. But the parties with a strong interest here are not parties that can act quickly enough.” That is why new funding is now being sought with all available resources. “It really is D-day.” Millions needed According to Sprangers, it is not yet possible to say exactly how much money is needed to keep the company afloat. He can say, however, Several million, The administrator adds that the staff salaries are, however, continuing to be paid. Sprangers emphasizes that the deferral of payment applies only to Resato Hydrogen Technology and not the other Resato companies.
